title: github
description: schema for Github cli tool configuration

path.description: The path to the repository key to add to the keyring. [Required]

force.description: Indicates if a potential pre existing repository key should be overwritten if found. Defaults to 'false'. [Optional].

version.description: The exact version to install. If omitted the latest one is installed. [Optional].

remove.description: Indicates if the application and repository information should be removed. Defaults to 'false'. [Optional].
